criteria.text: Identifies that the $8,000,000 Yarrow Holdings Ltd class action in the board minutes is omitted from the Prospectus legal proceedings and risk factors, creating disclosure liability, and recommends adding disclosure.
Identifies the undisclosed $2,500,000 interest-free loan to director Marcus Rosenthal that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Calculates the underwriting commission as $13,200,000 (6.0% of gross proceeds of $220,000,000) and identifies that the stated $15,180,000 is wrong.
Flags that the Prospectus is inconsistent with the board minutes on legal proceedings.
Shows the commission arithmetic (10,000,000 x $22.00 = $220,000,000; x 6.0% = $13,200,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
